title: HouseVis: global settings
description: Settings for the whole house, on every device (edited in the Windows app, menu "Globale Einstellungen …"). The file is optional; missing entries use the defaults.

^(\\$schema|_.*)$.description: Reference to the schema or a comment; ignored.

language.description: The app's language on every device showing this house. Without it each device uses its system language (German for every German variant, otherwise English).

indicators.description: Icon per indicator kind: "heating" and "cooling" for the rooms, and the kinds of the indicators in house.json (e.g. "music"). Icons are names from the app's list (src/model/indicatorIcons.ts, Fluent Emoji), e.g. "fire"; "hidden" instead of an icon: that kind is not shown (the default for "music-paused").
